items.claim: The fetched sharing guidance says the note owner should choose who can view or edit shared meeting notes.
items.snippet: Let the note owner choose who can view or edit shared meeting notes.

items.claim: The fetched guidance says a note's sharing UI should show who it is shared with and let the owner remove access.
items.snippet: Show who a note is shared with and let the owner remove access.

items.claim: The fetched guidance says the owner should be able to choose, for each person, whether they can view or edit a shared document.
items.snippet: Let the owner choose whether each person can view or edit a shared document.

items.claim: The fetched guidance says anyone-with-the-link access should be off by default.
items.snippet: Links that give access to anyone with the link should be off by default.

items.claim: The source advises detecting a conflict on the server when two people change the same record at about the same time, and telling the second person that the record changed.
items.snippet: When two people change the same record at about the same time, detect the conflict on the server and tell the second person that the record changed.
